notes.title: Gauntlet of Power Patch 4: The Temple and the Rogue
notes.notes:
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/9856238/0b247cbcf9759b91fa6e46431fc13a77875890ed.jpg

The new update for Heroes of Loot: Gauntlet of Power is now live! 

New Content:

– Hidden realm: The Temple
– New unlockable character: The Rogue
– New friendlies
– New enemies

Grab the update now: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2374320/Heroes_Of__Loot_Gauntlet_Of_Power/

More info:

Besides adding the new realm and characters, I made some small changes to balancing things out (especially for the easy mode).

I also made the realms more of a choice to go into or not, as it will mean you now skip one or two levels. So if you are in a hurry and want to speedrun the game, knowing where to find the entries to these realms is certainly key.. but I can imagine it might sometimes be more interesting to NOT take the realm-route and grab some extra loot in the levels you would otherwise skip.

If you need a little spoiler on how/where to find the Rogue unlock tokens, make sure to check the Orangepixel website for the Games Wiki.

notes.title: version 3.0.3 and 3.0.4
notes.notes:
Couple of updates pushed fixing the following:

- some sounds got played twice for a single even (overload!)
- music files are now in proper stereo 
- all sound files are converted, which made update 3.0.3 40mb+ big (sorry!)
- fix some issues with the O-options key in the menu

notes.title: version 3.0.0: resolutions, and input
notes.notes:
Sorry for the delay in updating this game, but I'm just one guy maintaining a bunch of older games, while also working on new ones (like Space Grunts and Heroes of Loot 2 !)

BUT! Here's a big update.. I just need your patience and feedback cause I might have introduced new bugs. It all seems to run fine in my tests, just that the code needed a lot of rewriting and re-ordering... so jump onto the forums if you run into new issues.

In this version you can set the resolution (windowed mode) alongside improved support (so the white-stripe problems should be history)

Also added support for setting your own keyboard configuration, default is arrow keys + x

Under the hood a lot of other things changed as I finally brought the game engine up-to-date.. still some things missing, but it should prove easier to maintain the game again from here on

so enjoy!
